description: Creates a new TIA project. Guard Gd4: the target directory must be EMPTY — if it isn't, serve returns 409 conflict (this tool passes the error through; rediscover/choose another directory). A project already open in this session is closed to make room: if it has unsaved changes the call is REFUSED with 409 `unsaved_changes` (nothing is changed) unless it carries `saveUnsavedChanges:true` (saves it first; recommended) or `discardUnsavedChanges:true` (DATA LOSS: only on an explicit human decision, never to get past the refusal; the client asks the human to confirm first). The response carries `boundProjectPath` and `modified` for the new project, and `savedProjects`/`discardedProjects`. Maps to POST /project/create. Long operation: may answer status:"running" + jobId — then call tia_job_status.

discardUnsavedChanges.description: DATA LOSS: close the modified project(s) WITHOUT saving; every unsaved change is lost for good. Only when a human explicitly decided to throw that work away, NEVER to get past an unsaved_changes refusal. Never together with saveUnsavedChanges.

saveUnsavedChanges.description: RECOMMENDED choice when a modified project would be closed: save every modified project this call closes, then close it. Without a flag such a call is refused with unsaved_changes and nothing is changed. Never together with discardUnsavedChanges.

withUserInterface.description: create with the TIA UI visible (default true)

name: tia_project_create
title: TIA — create project
